howIWork.heading: Start from the problem that needs solving.
body: Technology isn't always the first answer.
In many projects, the real issue is the work process, the flow of information, disconnected systems, or how a team uses technology.
That's why the need is understood first.
The solution might be a process fix, a new system, automation, integration, or the use of AI.
Technology is chosen once the problem is clear enough.
